name: ExitPackage — Negotiating the Severance They Already Wrote
description: A 4-round negotiation simulation for Director-level professionals facing separation. Practice reading the package for omissions, mapping ethical leverage, drafting a statute-anchored counter-letter, and holding the floor against HR pressure tactics to recover the 30-60 percent of value most people leave on the table.
view:
ExitPackage

They told you the role is gone. The package landed. You have 7 days to sign or counter.
Round 1 of 4
Package value
€60,000
Statutory floor
€0
Credibility
100/100
Lawyer engaged
No
Briefing

Your Decisions

Flag every item that is missing or below market.

Select your ethical leverage. Threats and bluffs will cost you credibility.

Compose the counter-letter. Anchor on statute. Engage counsel if the package is material.
